CSS Media Queries

Screen-only content
This is visible on screen (hidden in print).
Print-only content
This is visible only when printed.
@media (min-width: 600px)
Red when viewport >= 600px
@media (min-width: 1024px)
Purple when viewport >= 1024px
@media (max-width: 500px)
Orange when viewport <= 500px
@media (prefers-color-scheme)
Adapts to light/dark preference
@media (prefers-reduced-motion)
Respects reduced motion preference
@media (orientation)
Orientation
@media combined (400px - 900px)
Dashed border in range
Flex layout
Column 1
Column 2
Column 3
